description: The Stargate program is relaunched after Apophis attacks Earth. O’Neill, Carter, Daniel and Teal’c form SG-1 and begin exploring the gate network, searching for Daniel’s abducted wife while learning that the Goa’uld empire reaches across the galaxy and Earth is already in its sights.

s01e01-02.description: Apophis attacks through Earth’s Stargate, bringing O’Neill back to Abydos and leading to the formation of SG-1 with Carter, Daniel and the defecting Jaffa Teal’c.

s01e03.description: As Earth decides Teal’c’s fate, a hidden Goa’uld inside Stargate Command turns the base itself into the next battlefield.

s01e04.description: On a world shaped by Mongol traditions, Carter challenges the treatment of women while SG-1 tries to recover a kidnapped local girl.

s01e05.description: SG-1 brings a violent infection back from a divided world, causing Stargate Command personnel to regress into primitive behavior.

s01e06.description: The team searches for a missing SG unit and finds its commander ruling frightened villagers as though he were a god.

s01e07.description: A crystalline life-form creates a duplicate of O’Neill and sends it to Earth, where it searches through memories of Jack’s lost family.

s01e08.description: Hunting an invisible creature, SG-1 encounters Apophis and the seemingly primitive Nox, whose abilities overturn the team’s assumptions about power.

s01e09.description: O’Neill becomes infected with the accelerated aging process of an isolated human colony and races to find a cure.

s01e10.description: A Goa’uld-destroying device traps Teal’c and O’Neill underground, forcing Daniel to choose between rescuing them and saving Sha’re.

s01e11.description: Daniel uncovers the story of Ernest Littlefield, an explorer stranded through Earth’s Stargate in 1945, and joins a mission to bring him home.

s01e12.description: Teal’c returns to Chulak to stop his son Rya’c from receiving a Goa’uld larva, risking capture by his former people.

s01e13.description: After Daniel is believed killed on an alien world, SG-1 struggles with grief while he tries to escape an aquatic being holding him captive.

s01e14.description: The Goa’uld Hathor arrives on Earth and uses chemical influence to seize control of Stargate Command’s men.

s01e15.description: Carter bonds with an orphaned girl after SG-1 discovers a devastated settlement and a mysterious source of lethal radiation.

s01e16.description: Teal’c is put on trial for atrocities he committed while serving Apophis, forcing SG-1 to confront the human cost of his past.

s01e17.description: SG-1 rescues advanced refugees from a doomed planet, then clashes with Earth officials who want their technology more than their trust.

s01e18.description: A gate malfunction strands O’Neill and Carter in an icy cavern while the SGC searches for a destination it does not know exists.

s01e19.description: SG-1 returns from a mission only to discover that artificial duplicates have been made of them and believe they are the originals.

s01e20.description: Daniel enters a parallel reality where Earth is losing a Goa’uld invasion and returns with evidence that the same attack is approaching his world.

s01e21.description: Senator Kinsey moves to shut down the Stargate program just as Daniel warns that a Goa’uld invasion is imminent.

s01e22.description: With the SGC ordered closed, SG-1 disobeys orders and gates aboard an enemy vessel to stop Apophis and Klorel from attacking Earth.
